summary: The proposed patch changes the 'kbd' role to use 'addnodes.literal_kbd' instead of 'nodes.literal'. This change is likely intended to address the issue with compound-key separators in the 'kbd' role.

issues.description: The patch does not address the underlying issue with how compound-key separators are handled in the 'kbd' role. It only changes the node type used for 'kbd', which may not resolve the problem.
